title: Prove the FTL initial quarter and exact finite-horizon regret bound
head: codex/research-online-ftl-sharp
body:
Orabona v10's Theorem1.3 proof separately states an initial1/4 stability estimate and the finite-horizon regret bound1/4+4sum(t=2..T)1/t (printed5/PDF17). Expose both as genuine public Lean proofs for the existing causal FTL predictor; retain all five earlier proofs/one definition, including4+4logT. Prefix empirical-mean feasibility and global minimization produce the Be-the-Leader premises from the actual targets, then the proof splits the first round from later stability terms.

First bound requires only y0 in[0,1]; the refined bound requires T>0 and all t<T targets in[0,1]. The initial predictor is1/2, distinct from empty mean0; the final comparator is the produced feasible best-fixed mean. Exact Lean tail range(T-1) has denominators t+2 and is empty at T1. No assumed stability/regret/argmin certificate. Six named validation proofs check endpointquarter, midpointzero, outside2→9/4, one-roundquarter, actual two-roundregret3/4 versus bound9/4, and strict-prefix causality. These tests are not six book results.

Validation: focused builds;15 named kernel/axiom checks,13 exact proposition identities/full fences,9 prespecified actual proof VALUE pairs/2401 selected references; combined {'combined-root-v1': 9092, 'combined-Tests-v1': 9242}, 466 tests/7 existing skips. Clean local applicable Lean-verified site preserves10821 registry IDs/URLs/native hashes and adds exactly2proofnodes (10823 total); existing formulas/four curated links/otherBook cards and notes preserved, with 14 actual current reader/module pixel captures. Distinct required automated decoder/CONTRACT-repair/BODY/FINAL accepted, allR1–R8 discharged. Prior actor history disclosed; no human/external/runtime-model attestation. Actual initial rejected metadata/enumeration CONTRACT, v1 initial-reader scope pixel failure, FINAL M3 historical-registry delivery-binding rejection and path/binding/fence/role invocation failures retained with separately reviewed versioned repairs; applicable registry-v2/site-v2 bind the delivered evidence, no source target weakening. Separate gates; no single runtime enforces every paper/file/role convention.
